CADASTRE.Title: Cadastre
CADASTRE.GMOnly: Only the GM can create and edit Cadastre maps.

Manager.Title: Cadastre: maps
Manager.Empty: No maps yet. Start with “New map”.
Manager.DeleteConfirm: Delete the map {name}? An already exported scene is left untouched.

Hints.select: Click: select, drag: move. Selected wall: drag nodes and handles (Alt: independent handles), double-click a node: corner ↔ curve, double-click the wall: new node. Del: delete, Ctrl+D: duplicate. Selected object: corners to scale, circle to rotate (by 15°, Alt: free).
Hints.brush: Drag to paint the floor freehand. Alt: erases the floor.
Hints.shape: Rectangle, ellipse: drag (Shift: square, circle). Pen: click for a corner, click-drag for a curve, click the first point or Enter to close.
Hints.wall: Pen: click for a corner, click-drag for a curve, Enter or double-click to finish, click the first point to close. Freehand: drag. Ends snap to nearby walls, so a partition properly closes its room.
Hints.door: Click a wall to place a door.
Hints.prop: Click to place. R and Shift+R: rotate by 15°.
Hints.pan: Right click, middle button or Space + click: pan. Wheel: zoom. Esc: cancel the path.
Hints.fill: Click inside a room: lays the floor up to the walls (closed doors included). Outside, fills everything not enclosed.
Hints.path: Road, quay, river: draw the curve with the pen (click: corner, click-drag: curve, Enter: finish) or freehand. Width, floor and edge in the panel. With the select tool, drag its points to reshape it.
Hints.trees: Click: one tree. Drag: scatters trees within the brush, spaced by density. Every tree is unique; select one afterwards to move, rotate or resize it.

Panel.NoSelection: Nothing selected. Click a wall, a door or an object.
Panel.Name: Name
Panel.ApplyHint: Anything outside the new size is clipped (Ctrl+Z to go back).
Panel.NoTextures: No imported textures. The button on the right opens the library.
Panel.NoProps: No imported objects. The button on the right opens the library.

Export.Title: Export to scene
Export.Choice: This map already has a scene: {scene}. Updating it replaces its background and the walls placed by Cadastre; tokens, lights and hand-placed walls stay.
Export.Empty: The map is empty: nothing to export.
Export.Reduced: Very large map: the image is reduced to {size} px per side, Foundry stretches it to the scene size.
Export.Missing: Images not found, left blank on the scene: {list}

Library.Title: Cadastre: asset library
Library.MenuHint: Outside images (asset packs, your own files) used as objects or floor textures in the editor.
Library.AddFileHint: Add an image already in Foundry's data
Library.AddFolderHint: Import every image of a folder and its subfolders (an asset pack, for instance)
Library.UploadHint: Send images from your computer to the world
Library.Empty: The library is empty. Add a file, a whole folder, or upload images.
Library.Name: Name
Library.DeleteHint: Removes the asset from the library. The file stays in place, and maps using it keep their copy.
Library.PpcHint: 200 for most packs. A size written in the file name (“_2x1”) wins for objects.
Library.Truncated: Very large folder: only the first {n} images were read.
